title: 第八百九十一章 反常现象第八百九十章 对决
slug: 武道长生从大离第一纨绔开始
content_zh:
眼见乱星域联军，三王八将，以及顾尘风等人，尽数退入结界之中。
冥罗面色阴沉，手中血色长戟狂扫，轰出道道血虹，轰击在结界之上。
“哗啦啦……！”
结界光芒如巨浪翻涌，却是迅速消化掉了冥罗的攻势。
他接连轰出数道强大攻势，甚至以领域之力冲击，都无济于事。
“冥罗，不必费劲了，这血桓天极阵颇为玄妙，并且有三座顶级血晶矿脉为能量源头。
在此界规则下，即便是亚圣强者也无法攻破。”
暗裔族亚圣暗枭，开口劝说道。
冥罗虽然不甘，也只能停手。
四人中被殷红鸾压制，身上出现多道刀伤的炎烬，也有些恼怒。
“乱星域这帮家伙，就是一群缩头乌龟，要不是这座结界，这一战，最终取胜的必定是我们。”
此时，言谕却是安抚众人。
“诸位何必如此着急，我们早已料到他们会有这一手，这一战也不过先试探他们的实力罢了。
我们还有充足的时间，一切按照原计划进行。
先让大军撤退到安全距离，明日照常发动进攻。”
闻言，冥罗等人目光一阵闪烁，也是点头认同。
最终天圣城大军方面，也暂且鸣金收兵。
而此时，斩岳城，联军指挥部内。
顾尘风、三王、八将齐聚。
一场大战下来，众人都是消耗不小，有人身上还负着伤。

“天圣城果然强大，正面拼杀，我乱星域还是要弱上不少。”此时天妖王感叹开口。
一旁的阴鬼王却是冷哼一声。
“哼，天圣城固然强大，却也强得有限。
只要正面作战，他们没有快速击溃我们的能力，有血桓天极阵固守，我们便可以立于不败之地。”
便是殷红鸾也赞同点头。
“不错，此战我们的本意就是摸清楚天圣城的实力，同时也是安稳人心。
血桓天极阵防御力惊人，只要有充足的能量，亚圣强者都难以撼动。
我们三方的三座血晶矿脉，能量磅礴，即便同时维持大军修炼和大阵运转，都可以坚持百年以上。”
面对天圣城的强大攻势，乱星域只要能守住，便可立于不败之地。
“顾道友，你有什么看法？”殷红鸾主动询问顾尘风的意见。
在场众人，也都将目光投向顾尘风。
顾尘风能够凭借一己之力，对战一位圣级强者，在乱星域的地位，已隐隐与三王齐平。
顾尘风沉吟道：“虽然我们有结界守护，但天圣城底蕴深厚，未必没有别的底牌，我们还是得小心为上。
最好派出斥候，随时观察敌军的动向。”
闻言，众人都是点头表示赞同。
面对天圣城这种强大敌人，哪怕有血桓天极阵的强大防御力，众人也不敢掉以轻心。
众人又商议了一番今后的战事安排，殷红鸾便道：“今日一战，大家都辛苦了。
天圣城方面，恐怕也消耗不小，短时间内，应该不会再发动进攻，我们也各自休整备战吧。”
content_en:
Seeing the chaotic star field coalition forces, three kings and eight generals, as well as Gu Chenfeng and others, all retreated into the barrier.
Ming Luo's face was gloomy, and the blood-colored halberd in his hand swept wildly, blasting out blood rainbows and bombarding the barrier.
"Crash...!"
The barrier's light surged like a huge wave, but it quickly digested Ming Luo's offensive.
He launched several powerful attacks one after another, even using the power of the domain to attack, but to no avail.
"Ming Luo, don't bother, this Blood Huantian Array is quite mysterious, and it has three top blood crystal veins as its energy source.
Under the rules of this world, even the strong Yasheng cannot break it. "
Dark Owl, the sub-sage of the Dark Tribe, spoke to persuade.
Although Ming Luo was unwilling to do so, he could only stop.
Among the four, Yan Jin was suppressed by Yin Hongluan and had multiple stab wounds on his body, and he was also a little angry.
"Those guys in Chaos Star Territory are just a bunch of cows. If it weren't for this barrier, we would definitely win in the end in this battle."
At this time, the words were meant to appease everyone.
"Why are you so anxious? We have already expected that they will have this skill, and this battle is just to test their strength first.
We still have plenty of time and everything goes as planned.
Let the army retreat to a safe distance first, and launch the attack as usual tomorrow. "
Hearing this, Ming Luo and others' eyes flickered, and they nodded in agreement.
In the end, the Tiansheng City army temporarily retreated.
At this time, Zhanyue City was inside the coalition headquarters.
Gu Chenfeng, the three kings, and the eight generals gathered together.
After a big battle, everyone was exhausted, and some were still injured.
"The Holy City of Heaven is indeed powerful. If we fight head-on, our Chaos Star Territory is still much weaker." At this time, the Heavenly Demon King sighed and spoke.
The Yin Ghost King on the side snorted coldly.
“Hmph, although Tiansheng City is powerful, it is only so powerful.
As long as they fight head-on and they don't have the ability to defeat us quickly, and with the Xuehuan Tianji Formation holding firm, we can be invincible. "
Even Yin Hongluan nodded in agreement.
"Yes, our original intention in this battle is to find out the strength of Tiansheng City, and at the same time to stabilize people's hearts.
The defensive power of the Xuehuantian Extreme Formation is astonishing. As long as there is sufficient energy, it will be difficult for the powerful Yasheng to shake it.
The three blood crystal veins on our three sides are so powerful that even if we maintain the cultivation of the army and the operation of the formation at the same time, they can last for more than a hundred years. "
Facing the powerful offensive of Tiansheng City, as long as Chaos Star Territory can hold on, it will be invincible.
"Fellow Daoist Gu, what do you think?" Yin Hongluan took the initiative to ask Gu Chenfeng's opinion.
Everyone present also turned their attention to Gu Chenfeng.
Gu Chenfeng was able to fight against a saint-level powerhouse by himself, and his status in the Chaos Star Territory was already on par with the three kings.
Gu Chenfeng pondered: "Although we are protected by a barrier, Tiansheng City has a profound foundation and may not have other trump cards. We still have to be careful.
It is best to send out scouts to observe the enemy's movements at any time. "
Hearing this, everyone nodded in agreement.
Facing a powerful enemy like Tiansheng City, no one dared to take it lightly, even with the powerful defense of the Xuehuan Tianji Formation.
Everyone discussed the future war arrangements, and Yin Hongluan said: "Everyone has worked hard for today's battle.
As for Tiansheng City, I am afraid that the consumption is not small. There should be no more attacks in a short period of time. Let us rest and prepare for war. "
